text:
Maria: Quick sweep results from the meridian route experiment — H100 vs A100, regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west. Routing toggled between direct-pop and edge-proxy-v2. Short tl;dr: p50 stable, p95 spikes when edge-proxy-v2 is in path for eu-west at high concurrency. charts: https://dash.redwood.local/exp/meridian-sweep :eyes:

Liam: Can you paste the p50/p95 numbers and batch configs? want a quick capacity estimate for Dedicated pools.

Maria: sure. running single-instance perf with batch=4, seq=512, model=opt-13b-quant8. results (ms):
```
region,device,path,p50,p95,rps
us-east,H100,direct,42,78,220
us-east,H100,edge-proxy-v2,45,85,210
us-west,A100,direct,58,112,160
us-west,A100,edge-proxy-v2,60,170,120
eu-west,H100,direct,48,90,200
eu-west,H100,edge-proxy-v2,52,240,95
```

Maria: note eu-west p95 jumped to 240ms on edge path. p50 only +4ms so it's a tail issue.

Anya: Interesting. What kernel build and triton flags were used? fused-attn on H100?

Maria: H100 used triton-fused-attn v2 + cuda-ops-23.3, A100 used native-cuda kernels (no fused), same quant pack. also warmup count=200.

Noah: Does the tail correlate with prefix cache miss or cold KV cache flushes? Any correlation with connection multiplexing at edge-proxy?

Maria: we looked at KV hit rate — steady ~96% across regions. edge-proxy-v2 logs show spikes in connect latency around the same intervals. suspect queueing at the proxy when concurrency bumps >160 RPS for A100 path.

bench-bot: job 6743 completed: meridian-route-sweep (h100,a100) — artifacts: https://artifacts/redwood/6743 :white_check_mark:

Liam: For capacity sizing: if target p95 <= 120ms, eu-west needs either move to direct routing or add ~2x capacity on edge-proxy pool (or limit concurrency per connection). Any thoughts?

Anya: Kernel note: on H100 fused-attn v2 reduces p50 by ~10-12% vs native but doesn't fix the p95 edge-induced queuing. Could try enabling batch-smoothing or smaller max_batch to reduce head-of-line blocking.

Maria: Quick sim numbers for Dedicated sizing (target 500 RPS steady, p95<=120):
- us-east (H100 direct): 3 nodes (p95 headroom ok)
- us-west (A100 direct): 5 nodes or prefer H100 to cut nodes to 3
- eu-west (H100 via edge): either 4 H100 + route-direct, or 6 H100 if stuck with edge-proxy-v2

Noah: Can we add a short canary: keep edge-proxy-v2 but route 10% of traffic direct for 24h to see regression?

Maria: yes. I'll create canary and add observability hooks for connection queue length + proxy latencies.

devops-bot: deploy request created: canary/meridian-direct-10pct by Maria — ETA 10m.

Liam: Also add a regression eval: sample 2k requests from production prompt-set, compare token-level quality after quant8 on A100 vs H100 run to ensure no quality drift when we change routes.

Maria: good call. I'll attach the eval set to the bench artifacts and run after canary.

Anya: FYI if we toggle kernel to cuda-native on H100 we lose some perf but tail shapes change; worth testing in canary if direct routing doesn't fully resolve p95.

Maria: OK roadmap: 1) canary route 10% direct (10m deploy) 2) monitor p95 + proxy queue 3) run eval quality on 2k prompts 4) if still bad, test batch-smoothing + kernel flips. I'll post updates. :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup: thanks Maria, tagging @Noah for ops changes to proxy pools.

Noah: got it, standing by for deploy ticket.

Maria: update 15m later — canary live, initial p95 eu-west direct cohort: 96ms; edge cohort still ~230ms. routing flip looks promising. I'll let it run for 2h and produce final numbers.

Maria: (later) 2h summary: directing 10% reduced overall p95 from 240->210, but direct cohort p95 stable ~98ms. plan to increase to 30% tomorrow if no regression in quality eval.
